root_cause.text: The padata CPU offline callback (padata_cpu_dead) was registered in the CPU hotplug DEAD section (before CPUHP_TEARDOWN_CPU) where callback failure is not allowed, but the callback can return an error (e.g., -ENOMEM), leading to a kernel warning.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "Failure isn't allowed in hotplug states before CPUHP_TEARDOWN_CPU so move the CPU offline callback to the ONLINE section where failure is possible." The patch removes the registration at `CPUHP_PADATA_DEAD` and instead registers the offline logic as part of the `CPUHP_AP_ONLINE_DYN` state. The warning "DEAD callback error for CPU1" is attributed to padata_cpu_dead being the only callback in that region that returns an error.
